title: Orthodontic Benefit Riders Claims Manual — Number of Payments for a Carried Benefit
content:
**Cascade Ortho Rider cases after a change of orthodontist: how many payments.** For the first carried payment, the number of payments the carried benefit is spread over follows the months remaining on the latest transfer entry. No payment is added for treatment that runs longer than the original schedule.

| Months remaining on the latest transfer entry | Schedule | Payments the carried benefit is spread over |
|---|---|---|
| no more than the lump-sum months (6 on every rider) | any | a single payment |
| more than 6 | quarterly | the months remaining divided by three and rounded up, when that is fewer than the installments left on the original schedule |
| more than 6 | monthly | the months remaining, when that is fewer than the installments left on the original schedule |
| any other case, including a case with no transfer entry | any | the installments left on the original schedule |

## Installments left on the original schedule

Take the planned treatment months after the banding month, limit them to the rider's installment months cap, divide by the service-period length (one month, or three on a quarterly schedule) and round up. Subtract the installment payments on the case that have not been reversed. The result is never fewer than one.

| Rider | Schedule | Installment months cap | Lump-sum months |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cascade Ortho Rider Child 1000 | quarterly | 24 | 6 |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Child 1500 | quarterly | 24 | 6 |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Child 2000 | monthly | 24 | 6 |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Family 1500 | quarterly | 24 | 6 |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Family 2000 | monthly | 30 | 6 |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Family 3000 | monthly | 30 | 6 |

## Hypothetical cases

Monthly schedule, 14 installments left on the original schedule:

| Months remaining on the latest transfer entry | Payments |
|---|---|
| 6 | 1 (at the lump-sum limit) |
| 7 | 7 |
| 11 | 11 |
| 17 | 14 (17 is not fewer than 14) |

Quarterly schedule, 6 installments left on the original schedule:

| Months remaining on the latest transfer entry | Payments |
|---|---|
| 13 | 5 (13 divided by three is 4.33, rounded up to 5, fewer than 6) |
| 20 | 6 (20 divided by three, rounded up, is 7, not fewer than 6) |
